author: priya-raman
title: Require an Idempotency-Key header on settlement posting endpoints
body:
Posting endpoints now return 400 without the header. Webhook handlers use the processor's `event_id` as the key.

A repeat with the same key and body returns the stored response. A repeat with the same key and a different body returns 422.

See issue 233 for the incident and the decision.
